_comment: Nissan Patrol Y63, Australian spec, right-hand drive. Coming soon. Each environment has its own database, so publishing this page on one does not create it on the others. Recreate it with: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/create-car-page.mjs scripts/briefs/nissan-patrol-y63.json --env staging --publish (or --env production). Sources: nissan.com.au all-new-patrol (grade equipment, colours, engine, towing); nissan.com.au news 2026/august, 'Nissan announces pricing and key specifications for all-new Patrol in Australia', 27 August 2026 (the six-grade ladder and the MSRPs); CarExpert (Australian launch timing). Images are Nissan Australia press shots of a pre-production car, stored under public/cars/nissan-patrol-y63/.
upholstery: Synthetic leather on Ti, Ti+ and Ti-L; genuine leather on Ti-L+ and Ti-L Reserve
infotainment: Dual 12.3-inch displays on Ti and Ti+, dual 14.3-inch from Ti-L up, NissanConnect with Google built-in

grades.name: Ti
grades.summary: The entry to the range, and already the full dual-range four-wheel-drive hardware.
highlights: 3D fixed Intelligent Around View Monitor with invisible hood "skeleton view"
Synthetic leather seats and leather-accented steering wheel
Four-wheel drive with dual-range interlocking transfer case (4H & 4L)
NissanConnect connected car services with Google built-in

grades.name: Ti+
grades.summary: Ti equipment, plus the glass roof and the load-and-go hardware.
highlights: Tilt and slide power sunroof with panoramic glass roof
Privacy glass (second row and rear windows)

grades.name: Ti-L
grades.summary: Bigger screens, Klipsch audio and adaptive damping on 20-inch wheels.
highlights: 3D rotation Intelligent Around View Monitor with skeleton view hood

grades.name: Ti-L+
grades.summary: Ti-L hardware, trimmed properly: real leather and a front row that heats, cools and massages.

grades.name: PRO-4X
grades.summary: The off-road grade: adaptive air suspension, all-terrain tyres and the towing hardware.
highlights: Black alloy wheels on all-terrain tyres

grades.name: Ti-L Reserve
grades.summary: The flagship: 22-inch wheels, a second row that gets its own screens and massage seats for both front occupants.
highlights: Adaptive air suspension and eDamper electric shock absorber
Driver and passenger front massage seats

customData.label: Grades on this page
customData.value: Ti, Ti+, Ti-L, Ti-L+, PRO-4X, Ti-L Reserve

valuePoints.title: You buy at the Australian price, not a re-exporter's
valuePoints.description: Australia is one of the seven countries our own team buys in. You order the Patrol through the Australian retail network at the Australian price, and the margin a re-exporter would take on the way out stays with you.

valuePoints.title: One landed number, before you commit
valuePoints.description: Australian pricing is confirmed, so we map the duty, VAT and registration-tax position for your destination onto the grade you actually want and give you a single landed figure with the freight in it. You decide on the real number, not an estimate.

valuePoints.title: Right-hand drive, with the file to prove it
valuePoints.description: Our Australian office clears the car for export and prepares the pack your own authority asks for — build date, VIN, compliance and the exact grade specification — and we support your clearance at the destination port.

notes: The Y63 Patrol drops the V8 for a 317 kW twin-turbo V6 — order it in Australian spec, right-hand drive, in Ti, Ti+, Ti-L, Ti-L+, PRO-4X or Ti-L Reserve. It is the same 3.5-litre engine and nine-speed automatic in all of them, on a dual-range transfer case and rated to tow 3.7 tonnes braked, so the ladder from Ti to Ti-L Reserve is about wheels, screens and suspension rather than what is under the bonnet. Pick a grade above and the specification below follows it. Australia is one of the seven countries we buy in, so you can order this one at Australian retail and ship it to your own market. Nissan Australia confirmed pricing on 27 August 2026, from A$98,990 for the Ti to A$145,990 for the Ti-L Reserve, before on-road costs. Register your interest and we will come back with a landed cost for your country. Photography is Nissan Australia press imagery of a pre-production car; Nissan states that Australian specifications, features, design elements and availability are subject to change without notice.
